notes.title: The free trial version will be released at the end of December! Stay tuned~~
notes.notes:
The free trial version of "Cavalry Conflict: Three Kingdoms Conquest" is coming soon!

We are excited to announce that the free trial version of the game "Cavalry Conflict: Three Kingdoms Conquest" will officially launch at the end of December! This is a strategic simulation game set against the backdrop of Three Kingdoms history, where players will take on the role of commanders during that era, strategizing, deploying troops, and participating in intense national battles to experience the ups and downs of history and the contest of wisdom.

In this trial version, we hope to allow more players to personally experience the charm and fun of the game. Whether you're a Three Kingdoms enthusiast or a fan of SLG games, we sincerely invite you to try this game. We believe that through your participation, we can work together to create an even better game.

We highly value player feedback and suggestions. During the trial, we encourage every player to actively share their experiences and thoughts. Whether it's feedback on gameplay, interface design, or character balance, your opinions are crucial for us to continuously improve and refine the game. Your voice is vital in helping us enhance the game's quality and user experience.

Stay tuned for the free trial version of "Cavalry Conflict: Three Kingdoms Conquest," and we look forward to seeing you in the game! Let's join hands, battle through the Three Kingdoms, and write our own legendary chapter!

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45322586/4c5757a7700b96761754d1013dc644db4a70e58a.png

Content Includes:
Hero Development
A total of 108 heroes, featuring civil officials, military generals, and versatile classes, with unit types such as infantry, cavalry, archers, and sorcerers that counter each other. Heroes also include treasures, destinies, stars, deputy generals, formations, beast spirits, soul jade, battle strategies, reincarnations, and divine beings across eight major gameplay versions.

Fief Construction
Build barracks, resource fields, and technology enhancements within your fief.

Foreign Envoys
Foreign envoys are a national dungeon gameplay; only the rulers of the same nation can simultaneously face their country's foreign envoys. Victory will yield tribute rewards. The foreign envoy dungeons are divided into multiple levels, with higher levels presenting greater difficulty.

Regular National Wars
Players can attack ordinary cities at any time. This type of national war aims to prepare city routes for large-scale national wars, facilitating the occupation of key forts.

Golden City Wars
Large cities can be attacked daily from 12:00 to 14:00 and 20:00 to 22:00. Players can employ tactics such as ambushes and troop restrictions to disrupt the enemy. After capturing a city, more gold rewards will be settled during the autumn harvest each year.

Xiangyang Battle
All players on the server participate in attacking the largest city in the game (Xiangyang). The nation that survives in the main city of Xiangyang will become the overlord when the next Xiangyang battle begins and will receive the overlord rewards.
